name: Summer Internship
description: Students will be interning in an organization to develop experience in application of principles learnt in the program and to develop skills in communication, working efficiently in a team, learn to collaborate and gain exposure to practical/industry relevant problems. Students will be assigned a project by their reporting officer, where they have to work on real-world problems.
